title: Just because a game is on disc doesn’t mean it will work in the future
summary: While DoesItPlay doesn’t test these Game Key Cards alongside more legitimately “physical” releases, Itsel said he considers selling a physical product that amounts to a fancy download key to be “a form of deception” on the part of Switch 2 publishers.
